candidates.name: Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci)
candidates.economic_threshold: 8-10 adults per leaf (top 3 leaves), or visible leaf curl symptoms
candidates.monitoring: Yellow sticky traps (10-12/acre), leaf-turn count twice weekly
control_chemical: label-approved diafenthiuron or spiromesifen only past ET, never repeat same mode of action

candidates.name: Fruit borer (Helicoverpa armigera)
candidates.economic_threshold: 1 larva or 5% damaged fruit per plant on 20-plant scout
candidates.monitoring: Pheromone traps (5/acre), weekly larval count on 20 plants
control_cultural: deep summer ploughing to expose pupae
timely sowing to avoid peak moth flight
control_biological: NPV (nuclear polyhedrosis virus) spray at early instar
control_chemical: label-approved emamectin benzoate or indoxacarb only past ET, rotate mode of action
